preconditions.description: The number of rows in the matrix is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of columns in the matrix is between 1 and 20, inclusive.
Each cell in the matrix contains either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output list is not empty, containing the indices of the duplicate rows.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= row < R for row in output)
postconditions.description: All indices in the output list are within the range of valid row indices [0, R-1].
Each row index in the output list appears exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[row1] == matrix[row2] for row1 in output for row2 in output if row1 < row2)
postconditions.description: For any two distinct row indices in the output list, the corresponding rows in the matrix are identical.
